issues.title: arm ready --explain: append arm merged hint for done-but-not-merged blockers
issues.dod: When ExplainNotReady detects that a blocker is in status 'done' (not missing, not cancelled), the reason string appends ' — run: arm merged --issue <BLOCKER-ID>'. Blockers that are missing or in other statuses are unchanged. Unit tests cover the new hint path and the existing paths remain green. make check passes.
acceptance: arm ready --explain output for a task blocked by a done-but-not-merged issue includes 'run: arm merged --issue'
arm ready --explain output for a task blocked by a missing issue does NOT include the hint
all existing ready package tests pass

issues.title: deploy-skills: replace per-subdir conditionals with cp -r
issues.dod: The deploy-skills Makefile target replaces the separate 'if [ -d scripts ]' and 'if [ -d references ]' blocks with a single recursive copy of the entire skill source directory. Deployed output in .claude/skills/ and .gemini/skills/ is identical to before. make check passes.
acceptance: make skill deploys SKILL.md and all subdirectory files for all skills

issues.title: Add make validate-skills target and wire into make check
issues.dod: A new 'validate-skills' Makefile target runs grep assertions that enforce DoD constraints on skill bodies — specifically that 'make install' does not appear in any internal/skillsembed/skills/*/SKILL.md file. The target exits non-zero with an actionable error message if a violation is found. The 'check' target depends on 'validate-skills'. make check passes on the current clean state.
acceptance: make validate-skills exits 0 on a clean repo
make validate-skills exits non-zero and prints an error if 'make install' appears in a SKILL.md

issues.title: Coordinator skill: document background agent Bash limitation and worktree cleanup
issues.dod: internal/skillsembed/skills/armature-coordinator/SKILL.md is updated with: (1) a note in the Dispatch Protocol or Prerequisites section explaining that background agents do not inherit the parent session's Bash permissions and will block silently on shell commands — recommending direct implementation or foreground-agent worktrees instead; (2) a 'git worktree remove <path>' cleanup step in the 'After Workers Return' checklist. 'make skill' is run to redeploy to .claude/skills/ and .gemini/skills/. make check passes.
acceptance: SKILL.md contains a clear explanation that background agents cannot use Bash without explicit permission inheritance
SKILL.md 'After Workers Return' checklist includes a worktree remove step
